title: OpenSharing SecureConnect will be available by default for all accounts
body:
OpenSharing SecureConnect is [generally available](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types) and available by default for accounts on the Premium plan. For accounts on the Enterprise plan, Databricks will enable it automatically in mid-September 2026, and by early 2027 for the rest.

Until it is available for your account, an account admin on the provider side can turn on the **OpenSharing SecureConnect** preview from the **Previews** page in the account console. See [Share data behind a firewall with SecureConnect](/aws/en/opensharing/secureconnect-provider) and [Manage Databricks previews](/aws/en/admin/workspace-settings/manage-previews).
